messages:
michelle (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock DP screening criteria, SLA commitments for beta participants, and clear launch-readiness gates by EOD Wed. Can folks chime in with must-haves?
ron (Eng): +1. From infra side we need clear traffic profile and error budget allowances. Also: will we require dedicated capacity for any DP?
anya (Research): For feedback quality, recommend recruiting 18–25 partners and expecting 60–75% active feedback responders. Key metric: actionable feedback per week (>= 3 items/week).
sam (CS): We should prioritize customers who can commit to weekly sessions and a point-of-contact. Also prefer customers with existing privacy SLAs.
lee (Security): If any DP wants Private deployment or VPC connectivity, we need their network owners on the intake. Minimum: NDA + data processing agreement. No on-prem access before security review.
kev (Design): We need to include a short usability checklist in the intake so we can baseline flows. Proposed items: task completion time, 3 quick screen-recordings, and consent for session video.
michelle (PM): Draft qualification checklist proposal: 1) Use-case fit (must use streaming or embedding feature) 2) Commitment (weekly 1:1 + survey) 3) Data sensitivity (OK with DPA/NDA) 4) Contact availability 5) Willingness to share telemetry. Thoughts?
ron (Eng): Add: expected QPS and peak payload size. If QPS > 100 sustained, we surface to Dedicated capacity team. Also flag customers with long context windows (>8k) for quantization guidance.
anya (Research): + add sampling plan — we should capture 2 canonical prompts per partner and a prompt suite for regression checks. That will let Optimize team measure quality drift.
sam (CS): Suggested success criteria for pilot: - 3 customer integrations completed - 80% of scheduled feedback sessions held - 1 actionable product change identified and prioritized into roadmap.
lee (Security): SLA note: We can offer 99.9% API uptime during pilot but only if partners accept limited support hours (M-F 9-5) and no guaranteed RTO for on-prem work until review complete.
kev (Design): Can we make a one-pager for partners that sets expectations? I can mock a template by Tue.
michelle (PM): Timeline proposal: recruitment window 2 weeks, onboarding docs + template 1 week, pilot duration 6 weeks. Gate to launch: meet success criteria OR show clear plan to address gaps.
ron (Eng): For onboarding, include a quick checklist with commands for telemetry enablement, example curl, and a toggle to enable verbose tracing. Example snippet to include in docs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","input":"test"}'
```
sam (CS): Recruitment script (short): 
"Hi — we’re running a short design partner pilot to validate X. It involves weekly 30-min calls and quick feedback surveys. Are you available for a 6-week pilot starting May?"
anya (Research): Also capture consent in the intake form for telemetry + anonymized quotes. We need that for publication later.
michelle (PM): Outstanding items: 1) finalize checklist (kev) 2) recruitment email + screening script (sam/anya) 3) SLA language (lee) 4) infra thresholds & onboarding snippet (ron) 5) acceptance criteria doc (michelle). Can owners ack?
kev (Design): I got 1 — mock by Tue COB.
sam (CS): I own 2 — will post draft in #product tomorrow.
lee (Security): I own 3 — will add DPA bullet and a short risk matrix.
ron (Eng): I own 4 — will add traffic buckets and quick-start samples.
anya (Research): I own sampling plan and screening questions for prompt baseline.
product-bot: Scheduled: "DP Launch Readiness Sync" on 2195060000 (calendar invite sent).
michelle (PM): Thanks — let's aim to have a single-page acceptance checklist in repo before invites go out. If anyone sees blockers call them out now.
ron (Eng): Minor blocker — we need dedicated quota changes for 2 partners; will open a request ticket today.
michelle (PM): Noted. If no other blockers, I'll consolidate and publish the intake + SLA draft by EOD Wed. :thumbsup:
